reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I said I'd noted that the deadline for the signed Tamsin Cold Chain order form is 24 September, not the date in her #north-team post this morning. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

A signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to confirm it in that channel. One thing I didn't raise with her: 24 September is already past, since today is 14 October.
